topics.title: Metalyse TENACITY Trial — China Consideration for Late Window Indication Time Window

background.text: Leo Bao presented on the Metalyse TENACITY trial regarding China consideration for the time window for the late window indication. Multiple scenarios were discussed.
background.quote: Metalyse TENACITY trial (for late window indication)— China consideration for time window

decision.text: MAP suggests initially proposing Scenario 2 to the global team (Submit global CTP with a time window limit of 24h for China as a specific IC/EC criterion, and with key secondary objective within 24h), with Scenario 3 as back-up (Submit global CTP with a time window limit of 24h for China as a specific IC/EC criterion and with a pre-specified subgroup for 24h), to limit impact on global and mitigate local risk. MAP also suggests exploring the possibility of expanding the sample size in China, and highlighting the DMC setup in the trial for safety monitoring in the reply to CDE to address their
decision.quote: To limit the impact on global and mitigate local  risk, MAP suggests initially proposing scenario 2 to the global team (Submit global CTP with a time window limit of 24h for China as a specific IC/EC criterion, and with key secondary objective within 24h). Scenario 3 will be used as the back-up option (Submit global CTP with a time window limit of 24h for China as a specific IC/EC criterion and with a pre-specified subgroup for 24h). To explore the possibility of expanding the sample size in China.

todo.text: Metalyse Evidence team to propose Scenario 2 to global team, use Scenario 3 as back-up, explore expanding China sample size, and highlight DMC setup in reply to CDE, due June 2025.
todo.quote: Highlight the DMC setup in the trial for safety monitoring in the reply to CDE to address their concerns. | Responsible person: Metalyse Evidence team | Timeline: June 2025
